scripts.build:wasm: WASM_PACK=$(command -v wasm-pack || true); if [ -z "$WASM_PACK" ] && [ -x ../target/wasm-pack/bin/wasm-pack ]; then WASM_PACK=../target/wasm-pack/bin/wasm-pack; fi; if [ -z "$WASM_PACK" ]; then echo 'wasm-pack not found; installing locally with cargo'; cargo install wasm-pack --locked --version 0.13.1 --root ../target/wasm-pack; WASM_PACK=../target/wasm-pack/bin/wasm-pack; fi; "$WASM_PACK" build ../phasewasm --target web --out-dir ../web/src/wasm --out-name phasewasm
